description: This Java class defines a global exception handler using Spring's @RestControllerAdvice, providing centralized handling of various exceptions to return consistent API error responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring component that handles various exceptions globally to return proper HTTP responses.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles MethodArgumentNotValidException, returning validation error details.

methods.name: handleConstraint
methods.description: Handles ConstraintViolationException, returning the exception message.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles EntityNotFoundException, returning the exception message with 404 status.

methods.name: handleSecurity
methods.description: Handles SecurityException, returning a 403 Forbidden response.

methods.name: handleIllegalArg
methods.description: Handles IllegalArgumentException, returning the exception message.

methods.name: handleGeneral
methods.description: Handles generic Exception, returning a 500 Internal Server Error with a generic message.
